remarks: Look out to a grassy knoll, beautiful flowering trees, and stone wall from this picture perfect Prides Crossing condo. The entry invites you inside to the bright open floor plan. Enjoy the wood burning fireplace in the living room while looking through a wall of sliding doors to your recently expanded private stone terrace. You will enjoy entertaining in the Dining room. The beautiful kitchen with white cabinets and granite counters has a new range and hardware plus sunny breakfast area. The lower level was recently renovated with new sheetrock and carpeting. The unfinished area contains the laundry room and has plenty of room for storage. The two spacious bedrooms, both with closet organization systems and full baths, are on upper level. Several large windows in the primary bedroom create a bright and airy atmosphere. Other recent updates include new AC condenser, new kitchen windows and Murphy bed full wall unit in 2nd bedroom. This unit it is in move-in condition and meticulously maintained. There is a new pool and the Club house is delightful for hosting private parties. This well maintained and well funded complex is just a couple blocks to train, town, restaurants, shops and parks.
